goal: A developer can package a skill as an immutable checksummed version with a regression comparison against the last approved version, approve it explicitly, install only approved versions into the Claude or Codex project or user directory, see them in a registry of proven skills, and roll back to the previous approved version

plan.goal: Add release.py: skillz package creates an immutable semver version with a SHA-256 manifest and regression against the last approved version; skillz approve is the only way to approve; proven by tests/test_release.py

Add install.py: skillz install installs only approved versions into exactly the Claude/Codex project or user skills dir, records skills/registry.json, rollback reinstalls the previous approved version, list shows registry and history; proven by tests/test_install.py
Wire package, approve, install, rollback and list into the skillz CLI and prove the package-approve-install-rollback-list flow end to end (depends on release-package and install-registry)
